## REQ-LIFE-001

**Birth message on every connection**

A component publishes a Birth message whenever its connection to the broker is established, i.e. after every connect and every reconnect.

- Keyword: MUST
- Levels: L1 MUST · L2 MUST · L3 MUST
- Domain: messaging · Applies to: component
- Refs: MG 6, MG 6.3.3, SF-059
- Verification: d7-monitor, d7-test
- Status: draft
- Inventory: MG-6-31ee6521, MG-6.3.3-7027f33a

> This message must be published whenever the connection between client and broker is established.
> — MG 6.3.3

> The protocol version, the broker address and ports, the security settings as well as the birth message and the will message are mandatory for all levels.
> — MG 6

Notes: Graded by REQ-CMP-003. Proposed: the Birth message is the first publication of the component after the connection is established (SF-059 (c)). D7 checks it by forcing a reconnect of the application under test (test broker).

## REQ-LIFE-002

**Birth message topic**

The Birth message is published to the topic Oi4v2/<ServiceType>/<AppId>/Pub/MAM/<AppId>, i.e. the Source is the AppId of the component itself.

- Keyword: MUST
- Levels: L1 MUST · L2 MUST · L3 MUST
- Domain: messaging · Applies to: component
- Refs: MG 6, MG 6.3.3, MG 7.6
- Verification: d7-monitor
- Status: draft
- Inventory: MG-6-31ee6521, MG-6.3.3-55175294

> It must be published to the topic Oi4v2/<ServiceType>/<AppId>/Pub/MAM/<AppId>, i.e. the Source is the AppId of the application itself (7.6 Source Element).
> — MG 6.3.3

Notes: Graded by REQ-CMP-003. The topic syntax is area TOP.

## REQ-LIFE-003

**Birth message is the MAM of the component itself**

The Birth message is a complete Pub MAM NetworkMessage (MG 8.1) with one DataSetMessage of type MAM whose Payload is the Master Asset Model of the component itself (ProductInstanceUri is the component's own Identification Link). It is identical in content to the component's regular Pub MAM about itself and uses the same DataSetWriterId.

- Keyword: MUST (implicit, SF-035)
- Levels: L1 MUST · L2 MUST · L3 MUST
- Domain: messaging · Applies to: component
- Refs: MG 5, MG 6, MG 6.3.3, MG 8.1, SF-035, SF-057
- Verification: d7-monitor, schema
- Status: draft

> In an Open Industry 4.0 Alliance context, the Birth message contains a NetworkMessage with a DataSetMessage of type Master Asset Model (5 The Master Asset Model) of the application.
> — MG 6.3.3

> It refers to the topic resource MAM (7.5.1 Resources) and shares its payload.
> — MG 6.3.3

Notes: Keyword-less (SF-057 (f), proposed interpretation). The envelope rules of a Pub message apply (area MSG); the Birth message is a regular Pub MAM, so CorrelationId and ReplyTo are empty. Example: V-PAY-023.

## REQ-LIFE-004

**Birth message without Timestamp and SequenceNumber**

The DataSetMessage of the Birth message does not contain the optional keys Timestamp and SequenceNumber.

- Keyword: SHOULD NOT
- Levels: L1 SHOULD NOT · L2 SHOULD NOT · L3 SHOULD NOT
- Domain: messaging · Applies to: component
- Refs: MG 6.3.3, MG 8.2.3, SF-058
- Verification: d7-monitor
- Status: draft
- Inventory: MG-6.3.3-46e9d8ac

> The Birth message, which follows the format of a MAM message, should not contain the optional keys for Timestamp and SequenceNumber, because the content of this keys can not be pre-set.
> — MG 6.3.3

Notes: Kept as SHOULD NOT; B1.1.2 states "shall not" for the Will message (SF-058 (b), proposed interpretation). Both are regular optional keys of the DataSetMessage (MG 8.2.3), so a receiver accepts them.

## REQ-LIFE-005

**Close message before a graceful disconnect**

A component publishes a Close message before it closes its connection to the broker gracefully.

- Keyword: SHOULD
- Levels: L1 SHOULD · L2 SHOULD · L3 SHOULD
- Domain: messaging · Applies to: component
- Refs: MG 6, MG 6.3.4
- Verification: d7-test
- Status: draft
- Inventory: MG-6-4c5014ad, MG-6.3.4-4e696b67

> An application-driven message should be published in OI4 Alliance context before the connection is closed gracefully.
> — MG 6.3.4

Notes: Graded by REQ-CMP-009. A graceful disconnect discards the Will message at the broker; without a Close message other participants are not informed. D7 needs the application under test to be stopped gracefully.

## REQ-LIFE-006

**Close message topic**

The Close message is published to the topic Oi4v2/<ServiceType>/<AppId>/Pub/Health/<AppId>, i.e. the Source is the AppId of the component itself.

- Keyword: MUST
- Levels: L1 SHOULD · L2 SHOULD · L3 MUST
- Domain: messaging · Applies to: component

- Refs: MG 6, MG 6.3.4, MG 7.6
- Verification: d7-test

> It must be published to the topic Oi4v2/<ServiceType>/<AppId>/Pub/Health/<AppId>, i.e. the Source is the AppId of the application itself (7.6 Source Element).
> — MG 6.3.4

Notes: Graded by REQ-CMP-009.

## REQ-LIFE-007

**Close message content**

The Close message is a Pub Health NetworkMessage (MG 8.1) with one DataSetMessage of type Health whose Payload is Health NORMAL_0 and HealthScore 0. It uses the DataSetWriterId of the component's Health about itself.

- Keyword: MUST (implicit, SF-035)
- Levels: L1 SHOULD · L2 SHOULD · L3 MUST
- Domain: messaging · Applies to: component
- Condition: The component publishes a Close message (REQ-LIFE-005).
- Refs: MG 6, MG 6.3.4, MG 8.3.2, SF-035, SF-057
- Verification: d7-test, schema
- Status: draft

> The Close message contains the health information for a graceful disconnect of the application (8.3.2 Health).
> — MG 6.3.4

> It refers to the topic resource Health (7.5.1 Resources) and shares its payload.
> — MG 6.3.4

Notes: The payload is only given as a code block (SF-057 (g), proposed interpretation). Graded by REQ-CMP-009. Example: V-PAY-024.

## REQ-LIFE-008

**Will message registered on every connection**

A component registers a Will message in every MQTT CONNECT, with the topic Oi4v2/<ServiceType>/<AppId>/Pub/Health/<AppId> (the Source is the AppId of the component itself) and the Will Retain flag false.

- Keyword: MUST (implicit, SF-035)
- Levels: L1 MUST · L2 MUST · L3 MUST
- Domain: messaging · Applies to: component
- Refs: MG 6, MG 6.3.2, MG 6.3.5, MG 7.6, SF-035, SF-057
- Verification: d7-test
- Status: draft
- Inventory: MG-6-31ee6521

> The Will message is registered at the broker when the connection is established, with the topic Oi4v2/<ServiceType>/<AppId>/Pub/Health/<AppId>, i.e. the Source is the AppId of the application itself (7.6 Source Element).
> — MG 6.3.5

> The protocol version, the broker address and ports, the security settings as well as the birth message and the will message are mandatory for all levels.
> — MG 6

Notes: MG 6.3.5 has no keyword (SF-057 (h), proposed interpretation); the Will message is mandatory per the MG 6 note (REQ-CMP-003). Retain false follows from REQ-MQTT-018. D7 checks it by cutting the connection of the application under test (test broker).

## REQ-LIFE-009

**Will message content**

The Will message is a Pub Health NetworkMessage (MG 8.1) with one DataSetMessage of type Health whose Payload is Health FAILURE_1 and HealthScore 0. It uses the DataSetWriterId of the component's Health about itself.

- Keyword: MUST (implicit, SF-035)
- Levels: L1 MUST · L2 MUST · L3 MUST
- Domain: messaging · Applies to: component
- Refs: MG 6, MG 6.3.5, MG 8.3.2, SF-035, SF-057, SF-058
- Verification: d7-test, schema
- Status: draft

> The Will message contains the predefined health information for an ungraceful disconnect of the application (8.3.2 Health).
> — MG 6.3.5

> It refers to topic resource Health (7.5.1 Resources) and shares its payload.
> — MG 6.3.5

Notes: SF-057 (h). The Will message is composed at connect time; its MessageId carries the registration time (SF-058 (a), proposed interpretation). Example: V-PAY-025.

## REQ-LIFE-010

**Will message without Timestamp and SequenceNumber**

The DataSetMessage of the Will message does not contain the optional keys Timestamp and SequenceNumber.

- Keyword: SHOULD NOT
- Levels: L1 SHOULD NOT · L2 SHOULD NOT · L3 SHOULD NOT
- Domain: messaging · Applies to: component
- Refs: MG 6.3.5, MG 8.2.3, SF-058
- Verification: d7-test
- Status: draft
- Inventory: MG-6.3.5-1dce21f4

> The Last Will and Testament message, which has the format of a Health message, should not contain the optional keys for Timestamp and SequenceNumber, because the content of this keys can not be pre-set.
> — MG 6.3.5

Notes: B1.1.2 says "shall not" (SF-058 (b), proposed interpretation: SHOULD NOT as in MG 6.3.5).

## REQ-LIFE-011

**Subscribers interpret the Close message**

A subscriber that tracks the online state of applications (e.g. the Registry) interprets a Health message of an application about itself with Health NORMAL_0 and HealthScore 0 as Close message: the application went offline gracefully.

- Keyword: MUST
- Levels: L1 SHOULD · L2 SHOULD · L3 MUST
- Domain: messaging · Applies to: subscriber, registry
- Condition: The subscriber tracks the online state of other applications.
- Refs: MG 6, MG 6.3.4, SF-059
- Verification: manual, d7-test
- Status: draft
- Inventory: MG-6-4c5014ad, MG-6.3.4-f64e1fed

> Subscribers, such as the Registry, shall interpret a Health message of an application about itself with Health NORMAL_0 and HealthScore 0 as Close message: the application went offline gracefully.
> — MG 6.3.4

Notes: "Subscribers" read as subscribers that track the online state (SF-059 (b), proposed interpretation). Graded by REQ-CMP-009. A message "about itself" is one with Source equal to the AppId of the publisher.

## REQ-LIFE-012

**Subscribers interpret the Will message**

A subscriber that tracks the online state of applications (e.g. the Registry) interprets a Health message of an application about itself with Health FAILURE_1 and HealthScore 0 as an ungraceful disconnect: the application is offline and not available anymore.

- Keyword: MUST
- Levels: L1 MUST · L2 MUST · L3 MUST
- Domain: messaging · Applies to: subscriber, registry
- Condition: The subscriber tracks the online state of other applications.
- Refs: MG 6, MG 6.3.5, SF-059
- Verification: manual, d7-test
- Status: draft
- Inventory: MG-6-31ee6521, MG-6.3.5-2469c460

> Subscribers, such as the Registry, shall interpret a Health message of an application about itself with Health FAILURE_1 and HealthScore 0 as an ungraceful disconnect: the application is offline and not available anymore.
> — MG 6.3.5

Notes: SF-059 (b). Graded by REQ-CMP-003 (Will message mandatory at all levels).

## REQ-LIFE-013

**Online again after the next Birth message**

A subscriber that tracks the online state of applications considers an application that went offline (Close or Will message) online again only after it received the application's next Birth message.

- Keyword: MUST (implicit, SF-035)
- Levels: L1 MUST · L2 MUST · L3 MUST
- Domain: messaging · Applies to: subscriber, registry
- Condition: The subscriber tracks the online state of other applications.
- Refs: MG 6, MG 6.3.3, MG 6.3.5, SF-035, SF-057, SF-059
- Verification: manual, d7-test
- Status: draft

> The application is considered online again after its next Birth message (6.3.3 Birth Message).
> — MG 6.3.5

Notes: Keyword-less (SF-057 (i), proposed interpretation).

## REQ-LIFE-014

**Close and Will Health values are reserved**

An online component does not publish a Health message about itself with Health NORMAL_0 and HealthScore 0 or with Health FAILURE_1 and HealthScore 0 other than as its Close message (REQ-LIFE-007) or Will message (REQ-LIFE-009).

- Keyword: MUST NOT (implicit, SF-035)
- Levels: L1 MUST NOT · L2 MUST NOT · L3 MUST NOT
- Domain: messaging · Applies to: component
- Refs: MG 6.3.4, MG 6.3.5, MG 8.3.2, SF-035, SF-059
- Verification: d7-monitor
- Status: draft

> Subscribers, such as the Registry, shall interpret a Health message of an application about itself with Health NORMAL_0 and HealthScore 0 as Close message: the application went offline gracefully.
> — MG 6.3.4

> Subscribers, such as the Registry, shall interpret a Health message of an application about itself with Health FAILURE_1 and HealthScore 0 as an ungraceful disconnect: the application is offline and not available anymore.
> — MG 6.3.5

Notes: Follows from the interpretation by subscribers; not stated (SF-059 (a), proposed interpretation). A Health about an asset (Source other than the AppId) is not affected. Before a Close message a component still publishes its real Health; a HealthScore 0 with another Health state is allowed.
